props.gloss_en: R' Elazar: since the day the Temple was destroyed the gates of prayer have been locked
as it is said: 'though I cry out and plead, He shuts out my prayer' (Lam 3:8)
and although the gates of prayer have been locked, the gates of tears have not been locked
as it is said: 'hear my prayer, Lord, and give ear to my cry; do not be silent at my tears' (Ps 39:13)
Rava did not decree a fast on a cloudy day
because it is said: 'You have covered Yourself with a cloud, that prayer should not pass through' (Lam 3:44)
